description.fun: A three-headed robot dragon that looks like Hydreigon, except its side heads seem to think for themselves: they glance around, doze off and make their own decisions, and it can send them off alone or fire them like missiles. A paranormal magazine reported one razing a whole building with a single blast, and the Pokédex mentions a rumour that it's the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.
description.guide: A Dark and Flying-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Violet, said to be either a future relative of Hydreigon or a version of it from a parallel timeline. Its name comes from the Latin jugulum, meaning throat or neck.
description.tagline: A robot Hydreigon whose side heads have minds of their own
